description:
## Context

Agent-inbox today stuffs every enabled tool into every turn. This research shapes the replacement: a Qdrant-backed semantic index over three surface types (proto tools, CLI commands, widgets), with two retrieval tracks active simultaneously in auto-mode — agent-led (meta-tools the agent invokes on demand) and passive (user-message-embedded matching that surfaces suggestions and auto-renders widgets).

## Research Goals

1. **Index schema**: Qdrant payload layout for a descriptor (surface type, scenario, id, name, description, category, tags, embedding doc source). Shared shape across all three surface types.
2. **Embedding model**: local (Ollama) vs hosted (OpenAI/Voyage/etc.). Benchmarks on a representative eval set: recall@K, latency, cost. Local aligns with the shared-local-resources vision but may cost quality.
3. **Re-index triggers**: scenario startup (tools, commands), UI build (widgets), manual refresh, file-watcher. Minimum viable trigger set.
4. **Agent-led meta-tools**: exact shape of `search_tools`, `search_commands`, `search_widgets`. Parameters, result payload shape, token cost of always-having-them-in-context.
5. **Passive track UX**: when to surface suggestions vs auto-render widgets vs stay silent. Confidence thresholds. Multi-widget-per-turn policy (render both? pick highest?).
6. **Latency budget**: target `<200ms` added to first-token. Decompose: embedding + Qdrant query + assembly. Identify risks.
7. **Eval set design**: the routing eval — pairs of (user message, correct surface) for benchmarking recall. Size, diversity, how it gets maintained.
8. **Descriptor shape coordination**: `execute/cli-conversational-agent-inbox-client` and the tool/widget producers all need the same descriptor contract. Define it here.

## Deliverables

- Qdrant schema + payload contract
- Embedding model choice with benchmark results
- Re-index trigger set
- Agent-led meta-tool definitions (JSON Schema)
- Passive track UX spec with confidence thresholds
- Latency budget with decomposition
- Eval set v1 + maintenance plan
- Shared descriptor contract
name: unified-retrieval-index-design
title: Design the unified retrieval index and dual-track UX for agent-inbox
